description: Retire agro node into agro hands. `agro node` (`.agro/cli/src/commands/node.ts`) and the console provider of `agro hands` (`.agro/cli/src/lib/hands/console-provider.ts`) both call `POST /api/nodes`, `GET /api/nodes`, and `DELETE /api/nodes/<id>` through `.agro/cli/src/lib/console-api.ts`. This task removes `agro node` and moves each capability that only `agro node` has into `agro hands`.

userStories.title: Console hands accept operator authority and a per-call provider
userStories.description: As an operator on a host without a brain token, I want `agro hands` to use my `agro auth login` credentials and to accept `--provider console|exedev`. Then I can manage console VMs on any host without `agro node`.
acceptanceCriteria: `agro hands` accepts `--provider console` and `--provider exedev` (also `--provider=<id>`) before or after the verb, and the flag overrides `hands.provider` in the host config.
`agro hands list --provider desktop` exits 1 with an error that names `console` and `exedev`.

For the console provider, the token source order is `AGRO_CONSOLE_TOKEN`, then the brain token file, then the credentials file that `agro auth login` writes. The URL order is `AGRO_CONSOLE_URL`, then the brain console URL file when the brain token file supplies the token, then the credentials file URL, then `https://console.mifune.dev`.
With no token from any source, a console verb exits 2. The message names the brain token path and `agro auth login`.
Tests in `.agro/cli/src/commands/__tests__/hands.test.ts` cover each source order row, the missing-token exit 2, and the `--provider` override of a host config that selects `exedev`.
`agro run -- pnpm typecheck` exits 0 and `agro run -- pnpm test` exits 0.
userStories.notes: C1 executed: hands.test.ts --provider before/after verb and = forms over exedev host config, vitest exit 0. C2 executed: unknown provider test exit 1 names console and exedev. C3 executed: source-order table test. C4 executed: runHands exit 2, no request. C5 executed: hands tests 166 pass; worker saw 22 red before change. C6 executed: agro run -- pnpm typecheck exit 0; agro run -- pnpm test exit 0 (128 files, 3552 tests) by advisor.

userStories.title: Console hands create, list, and destroy cover the node flags
userStories.description: As an operator, I want `agro hands create` to take `--profile`, `--docker`, `--t3`, `--code-server`, `--ssh-key`, and `--json` for console hands so that every `agro node create` request has a hands form.
acceptanceCriteria: `agro hands create` accepts `--profile agro|sandbox` (default `sandbox`), `--docker`, `--t3`, `--code-server`, repeatable `--ssh-key <uuid>`, and `--json`. Each app flag without `--profile agro` exits 1 with `<flag> requires --profile agro`.
The create request body sends `profile`, `docker: true`, `t3: true`, `runtimeSettings: { codeServerEnabled: true }`, and `sshKeyIds` exactly as `agro node create` sent them on `ef52a983`.

Without `--ssh-key` and without a brain token file, `create` finds `~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub` in `GET /api/ssh-keys` or registers it with `POST /api/ssh-keys`. Then `create` sends the key id. On a brain, `create` sends `sshKeyIds` only for `--ssh-key`.
HTTP 422 `DISPOSABLE_PROFILE_UNSUPPORTED` prints `only a sandbox node can be disposable: drop --disposable, or use --profile sandbox`.

`create --json` prints one JSON line with `id`, `index`, `alias`, `name`, `status`, `spec`, `sshHost`, and `ssh`. The `ssh` field holds `ssh sandbox@<sshHost>` or `null`. When the console returns a node id and the wait then fails or times out, `create --json` prints that line before it exits 1.
Console `list --json` rows add `name` and `profile`.
Console `destroy` prints `destroy needs the admin role in agro-console` when the console returns HTTP 403.
With the exedev provider, `--profile`, `--docker`, `--t3`, `--code-server`, and `--ssh-key` exit 1 before any `ssh exe.dev` call. The refusal says that the flag applies only to console hands.

Tests in `.agro/cli/src/commands/__tests__/hands.test.ts` cover each row above. The ported cases from `.agro/cli/src/__tests__/node.test.ts` for profile flags, SSH key resolution, and `--json` pass against `runHands`.
`agro run -- pnpm typecheck` exits 0 and `agro run -- pnpm test` exits 0.
userStories.notes: Round 1 repaired: missing local key now exits 1 with no console call (node parity). C1-C8 executed: hands.test.ts and hands-exedev.test.ts cases for profile/app flags, request body, key find/register and brain no-key, 422 line, --json success and failure line, list name/profile, 403 destroy, exedev console-only refusals; vitest commands/__tests__ exit 0. C9 executed: ported node cases pass under runHands. C10 executed: agro run -- pnpm typecheck exit 0; agro run -- pnpm test exit 0 (128 files, 3597 tests).

userStories.title: Capture manual review evidence
userStories.description: As a reviewer, I want a command transcript of the hands console flow and the removed node command. Then I can accept the change without a live console spend.
acceptanceCriteria: `.agro/tasks/retire-agro-node/evidence/manual-review.md` holds a transcript of the built CLI entry point. The transcript runs `agro node list` and `agro hands --help`. With `--provider console`, it runs `agro hands check`, `create --profile agro --t3 --json`, `list --json`, and `destroy --yes`.

The console calls go to a local stub HTTP server on a free port. The transcript sets `AGRO_CONSOLE_TOKEN` and `AGRO_CONSOLE_URL` inline, under a new temp `HOME` with no credentials file. The transcript creates no live console resource.
The story stops the stub server. The story then deletes the temp `HOME` and reports.
